_comment: Map catalog of finished maps on Google Drive – which there are and where. The top key is the country, under it `regions` and `subregions`; keys starting with `_` are catalog metadata, not countries. Written at the end of a build by workers/deploy/publish-map.py; never edited by hand.

base.description: the whole OSM cartography – areas, lines, labels, waymarked trails and the offline search index
base.detail: Cartography, waymarked trails and landscape, with water, boundaries, roads, railways, settlements and points

signs.description: the country's rail and road signs (sprite)

boundaries.description: OSM boundaries of state, region, district and municipality, with the names of those areas (.pmtiles)
boundaries.detail: State, region, district and municipality, with names

credits.work: Hillshading, 3D terrain, contours and rock faces

contours.description: contour lines from the height model (.pmtiles)
contours.detail: Contour lines from the height model

points.description: OSM point features – springs, caves, lookouts, monuments (.pmtiles)

railways.description: every OSM railway and cable car including those under construction, planned and abandoned, named stations, line signs and the track network the phone routes trains on (.pmtiles)
railways.detail: Railways, trams, metros and cable cars – open, planned or gone – with stations and routes

roads.description: the OSM road network – motorways to steps, ferries and lifts (railways are in `railways`), with road limits, house-numbered addresses and the signed routing network the phone routes on (.pmtiles)
roads.detail: Roads, paths, ferries and lifts with their limits, house numbers for search, and routing

credits.work: Hillshading, 3D terrain, contours and rock faces

rocks.description: rock areas from the slope of the height model or from hillshading (.pmtiles)
rocks.detail: Cliffs and rock areas, from the terrain's slope

settlements.detail: Every building with its floor area and name, and the places they make up
